name: Shimmering Flats
summary: At Thousand Needles' southeastern edge, the Shimmering Flats stretch between the salt pan and Tanaris. The old lakebed now draws racers to the Mirage Raceway, where gnome and goblin tinkerers test their machines among desert beasts.

sections.title: A Bed of Salt and Speed
sections.body: Beneath the southern sun, the Shimmering Flats lie bare, with bleached turtle bones and the wooden wreck of an ancient sailing vessel. Their level salt crust makes them Kalimdor's chief ground for testing experimental vehicles. At the heart of the flats, the Mirage Raceway gathers gnome and goblin tinkerers for fierce contests. Rocket cars, gyrocopters and engines roar across the salt. Their makers chase speed, and fiery crashes leave smoking craters behind.

sections.title: Hazards of the Salt
sections.body: Beyond the raceway, hardened basilisks, aggressive scorpids and circling vultures hunt across the open flats. Farther south, the ground turns treacherous around the Rustmaul Dig Site. Dwarven prospectors first excavated the quarry, then the Horde contested it. The site was abandoned when picks broke into underground tunnels and unleashed vicious silithid across the southern edge of the flats.

faq.q: Why is there a ruined ship out in the middle of the desert?
faq.answer: The Shimmering Flats were once a vast inland lake. The wreck in their northern stretch is a remnant of that lake, which dried up long ago and left the salt pan and vessel behind.

faq.q: Why are gnomes and goblins here together?
faq.answer: The level salt crust gives rocket cars and other machines ideal testing ground. Gnomes and goblins founded the Mirage Raceway instead of fighting over territory. Now their tinkerers strive to outdo one another in speed, engineering and daring.

faq.q: What happened to the dwarven dig site in the south?
faq.answer: Dwarven archaeologists established the Rustmaul Dig Site, then a Horde raiding party led by Moktar Krin attacked them. The diggers broke into an underground silithid hive. The swarms drove everyone out and overran the southern flats.

faq.q: Where does the road through the Shimmering Flats lead?
faq.answer: The tracks southeast across the Shimmering Flats lead through a mountain pass into Tanaris, to the neutral port of Gadgetzan.

angles.text: For engineers, the salt flats offer scrap, fuel experiments and high-speed trials. Goblin and gnomish machinists keep the rivalry at the Mirage Raceway alive.
At the Mirage Raceway, gnomish pilots defend their engineering pride against the volatile, explosive designs of their goblin rivals.
